name: webhook

scripts.conformance: npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract webhook.list --contracts ${CAK_REGISTRY:-$HOME/cak-registry}/contracts/community --args '{}' && npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract webhook.create --contracts ${CAK_REGISTRY:-$HOME/cak-registry}/contracts/community --args '{"name":"conformance-test","prompt":"收到：{{body}}"}' && npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract webhook.delete --contracts ${CAK_REGISTRY:-$HOME/cak-registry}/contracts/community --args '{"name":"nonexistent"}'

description: CAK 插件：本机 HTTP webhook，外部系统一个 POST 就能把 agent 叫醒（webhook.create / list / delete）
